scope.description: A label that groups notes. On an edit, leave it out to keep the stored scope, or send null to clear it.

tags.description: On an edit, leave out to keep the stored tags, or send [] to clear them.

links.description: On an edit, leave out to keep the stored links, or send [] to clear them.

id.description: Edit this note instead of adding a new one. An edit changes only the fields you send.

expectRevision.description: The revision you last read; required with id.
